products.title: DRAGON BALL Z Grandista-BROLY
products.description:
Dominating the shelf with an impressive presence, the DRAGON BALL Z Grandista-BROLY- figure by BANDAI Spirits Banpresto captures the raw power of the Legendary Super Saiyan. This non-articulated statue is a masterclass in scale and accuracy, bringing the iconic character from the classic Dragon Ball Z films to life in stunning detail.

Every inch of this figure highlights Broly's massive physique, from the defined muscularity of his back and shoulders to the intricate folds of his signature red waist wrap. He is captured in his legendary form, featuring vibrant, lime-green spiked hair and pupil-less eyes that reflect his battle-ready state. Small scars are visible across his chest and arms, emphasizing his history of combat. His golden neckpiece, arm guards, and shin plates are finished with a metallic luster, accented by deep blue orb insets that pop against the matte skin tones. Broly stands in a wide, commanding stance with one hand outstretched, making him a centerpiece for any Dragon Ball collection.

products.title: HG 1/144 Z’GOK(SEED FREEDOM Ver.)
products.description:
Dive into the action of "Mobile Suit Gundam SEED FREEDOM" with the HG 1/144 Z’GOK (SEED FREEDOM Ver.), a remarkable High Grade model kit from BANDAI HOBBY. This kit captures the distinctive mobile suit with its special defenses and dynamic capabilities, ready to recreate iconic scenes from the film.
Experience unparalleled poseability thanks to the unique SEED Action System, specifically designed for this Z’GOK. It meticulously recreates the flexible arm and leg segments, alongside a wide range of motion at the waist, allowing for various impressive and action-packed displays.
Enhance your display options with interchangeable parts, including a damaged head armor piece to reflect intense combat scenarios. The kit also features specialized heated Claw parts, which can be swapped with the normal claws to authentically recreate its appearance from the movie. The internal frame design of this Z’GOK is modeled after the "INFINITE JUSTICE GUNDAM Type II," offering a unique detail for enthusiasts and allowing for some parts from the separately sold HG 1/144 INFINITE JUSTICE GUNDAM Type II to be combined with it.

- Backpack x 1
- Heat Claws x 2
- Damaged Armor x 1
- Beam effects x 4
- Stickers x 1

products.title: GOVERNOR EX ARMOR TYPE: QUETZAL
products.description:
Model Information:
There is a Governor with extrasensory perception abilities that hunted the Valiant Force. These hunters were superhuman soldiers designed to use a special armor type developed by Hakua Riken along with Monoceros, and are known as the black hunter, or Quetzal.
Like Monoceros, these super soldiers have artificially strengthened tissue, but Quetzal’s design and purpose varied from its counterpart. Quetzal was designed with highly sensitive vision, hearing, and olfactory perception abilities. This gives it innate threat-perception capabilities that drastically increase its ability to survive on the battlefield. In contrast with Monoceros, which was designed as an offensive model, Quetzal is designed to defend its allies, and has proven highly effective in the field.

Compared to the white soldier Monoceros, which emphasizes ferocity and battle-honed reflexes, Quetzal favors balance and stability. Due to the nature of the machine, Quetzal does not require as many cerebral nerve modifications as its counterpart, and is comparatively less harsh on subjects. For this reason, Quetzal is used more widely than Monoceros.
Due to the fact that the Ex Armor Types and the super soldiers that pilot them are both extremely new weapon systems, there are few active models seen on the battlefield. Despite this fact, the Liberty Alliance’s perception of the armor types and soldiers is favorable, and there are high expectations for Hakua Riken’s super soldiers in the future.

Weapons:
■ Security Cloak
■ Compound Bow
■ Crossbow

Product Specifications:
■ The model stands at a small 89mm tall and features 28 points of articulation.
■ Parts Materials: The body is made of ABS, and the POM hand parts and HEXA G-R.A.M back parts are made of PVC, boasting a wider range of movement.
■ The figure can be posed shooting the bow using the included dedicated hand parts.
■ The included crossbow and bow can be held by the model or mounted to the 3mm connection joints or other locatio

products.title: RUST Colour Set
products.description:
The SMS Rust Colour Set has been designed specifically to give you the 4 best colour tones to create realistic rust effects on your model.

Airbrush on the Dark Orange Rust Colour first as a base, then go over in a mottling fashion with Light Orange Rust to create a tonal difference. Then with a paint brush, brush on some random splotches using a dark blue colour such as SMS PL71 Insignia Blue and then around the edges of that with Red Rust, Red Oxide or a dark brown colour of your choice.
Then tie it together with a very light dusting coat of Red Rust or Red Oxide through the air brush and finish up by dry brushing on a mix of SMS Weathering Pigments Earth & Red Earth.

Experiment and find out the best way that works for you!

products.title: HG 1/144 GUNDAM AGE-FX
products.description:
Experience the ultimate form of the AGE System with the High Grade 1/144 Gundam AGE-FX, a standout model kit from BANDAI HOBBY. This highly articulated kit captures the dynamic presence of the AGE-FX from the "Mobile Suit Gundam AGE" series, allowing for a wide range of expressive poses once completed.
The Gundam AGE-FX is renowned for its C-Funnels, and this kit faithfully recreates their iconic "Full Burst Mode" with a clear ring display stand. Position the numerous effect parts to showcase the mobile suit's devastating offensive capabilities. The kit also features a removable Core Fighter, adding to its authenticity and playability.
Crafted from durable plastic, this model kit is designed for effortless assembly without the need for glue, providing a straightforward and high-quality building experience. Translucent plastic and foil stickers are included to help recreate the vibrant colors of the mobile suit.
Included in the box:
- Pieces to build the HG 1/144 Gundam AGE-FX
- Clear ring effect part display stand for C-Funnels
- Stungle Rifle, which transforms into the Daidal Bazooka
- Removable Core Fighter
- 14 C-Funnels (6 large, 8 small)
- Interchangeable hands (2 closed fists, 2 weapon-holding hands, 1 open left hand)
- Instruction manual

products.description:
Elevate the detail and dynamic presence of your Gunpla with the Builders Parts HD MS Vernier 02. These precision-molded optional parts are designed to enhance your Mobile Suit Gundam model kits, providing powerful and realistic thrusters for an authentic, customized look. Perfect for modelers seeking to add an extra boost of speed and intricate mechanical flair to their creations, this set allows for versatile customization across various Mobile Suit designs.
Crafted from durable plastic, these verniers are ideal for upgrading your 1/144 scale Gunpla, bringing a new dimension of realism and personalization to your collection. Whether you are aiming for a Federation or Zeon aesthetic, the included assortment of thruster types offers flexibility in design.
Included in this set:
- 2 Large square shaped burners (Federation)
- 2 Small square shaped burners (Federation)
- 2 Large circular shaped burners (Zeon)
- 2 Small circular shaped burners (Zeon)
- Instructions (may or may not include English translation)

products.title: BUILDERS PARTS HD MS WING 01
products.description:
Elevate your Mobile Suit Gundam model kits with the BUILDERS PARTS HD MS WING 01, an official Bandai Hobby customization set designed to enhance mobility and add dynamic flair to your Gunpla. These meticulously crafted conversion parts allow for detailed upgrades, bringing a new level of personalization to your favorite models.
This set introduces a versatile mobility enhancement system, featuring movable wing parts that can be posed to create exciting action scenes. The stabilizers are fully articulated, offering a wide range of display options. Each component is precision molded to ensure a perfect fit, making the building experience rewarding for modelers of all skill levels.
The parts are molded in colored plastic, often requiring little to no paint to achieve a finished look, allowing you to quickly integrate them into your existing Gunpla collection. The universal 3mm peg system ensures broad compatibility, making it easy to connect these wings to various model kits.
Included in this set:
- Two movable stabilizers
- Four long wing pieces
- Four short wing pieces

products.title: Figure-rise Standard ULTRAMAN ZERO
products.description:
Bring home the formidable young warrior with the Figure-rise Standard Ultraman Zero model kit from BANDAI HOBBY. This highly anticipated release marks the second installment in the Figure-rise Standard Ultraman series, allowing fans to build and display the iconic hero in dynamic poses.
Experience meticulous detail with this snap-together kit. The characteristic designs of Ultraman Zero's chest and shoulders are faithfully reproduced through precise part separation, ensuring a vibrant and accurate appearance right out of the box. The complex red, blue, and silver color blocks on the abdomen and legs, along with the gold and silver armor-like chest and shoulders, are achieved through molded part colors and minimal color-correcting stickers, offering a high level of completion without the need for extensive painting.
Enhance your display options with a variety of included accessories. The Ultimate Bracelet can be easily attached or removed to suit your preferred look. Both blue and red Color Timers are provided, along with corresponding Zero Twin Shoot reproduction parts, allowing you to recreate different power states.
What's Included:
- Pieces to build Ultraman Zero
- Zero Twin Sword × 1
- Zero Slugger × 2
- Head part (for Zero Slugger use) × 1
- Parts for Zero Twin Shoot × 2 types (blue and red)
- Color Timer × 2 types (blue and red)
- Ultimate Bracelet × 1
- Set of hand parts × 1
- Stickers × 1
- Instructions
Specifications:
- Height: Approximately 6.46 inches (16.41cm)
- Material: Plastic
- Assembly: No glue required; a hobby nipper is recommended for part removal

- Manufacturer: BANDAI HOBBY

products.title: HG 1/100 YF-19
products.description:
Experience the iconic YF-19 from the Macross series like never before with this High Grade 1/100 scale model kit from BANDAI HOBBY. Commemorating the 40th anniversary of the Macross anime, this kit introduces a new standard for transformable models, capturing the essence of the advanced variable fighter.
This YF-19 features the innovative "Replacement Three-Stage Transformation (Shortcut Change)" system, meticulously re-evaluating deformation, form, and movability. By incorporating strategic parts replacement, the transformation sequence is simplified, allowing for effortless conversion between its distinct Battroid, Gerwalk, and Fighter modes. This new system ensures that the intricate forms and setting images of each mode are pursued and realized in three dimensions, free from the constraints often found in fully transforming mechanisms.
Enjoy an enhanced range of articulation, achieved by eliminating complex internal structures to provide new levels of poseability and movement. The canopy part utilizes "polarization molding," creating captivating color variations that shift with the angle and intensity of light.
Included in the box:
- Gun pod x 1
- Shield x 1
- Effect parts for Pinpoint Barrier Punch x 1
- Landing gear x 1 set
- Parts for Fighter form reproduction x 1 set
- Parts for Gerwalk form reproduction x 1 set
- Joint parts x 1 set
- Hand parts x 1 set
- Name stickers x 2
Specifications:
- Scale: 1/100
- Material: Plastic
- Approximate Height (Battroid mode): 12 inches (30.48 cm)

- Manufacturer: BANDAI HOBBY

- Series: Macross

products.title: HG 1/144 GELGOOG Menace (LUNAMARIA HAWKE CUSTOM)
products.description:
Unleash the striking presence of Lunamaria Hawke's custom mobile suit with the HG 1/144 GELGOOG Menace. Directly from the cinematic adventure of "Mobile Suit Gundam SEED FREEDOM", this High Grade kit from BANDAI HOBBY captures the distinctive red and black color scheme and aggressive styling of Lunamaria's personal machine.
This model kit incorporates the innovative SEED Action System, an internal structure specifically engineered to allow for dynamic and iconic action poses seen throughout the "Mobile Suit Gundam SEED" series. Experience exceptional articulation, including a natural standing knee pose despite the suit's voluminous design, ensuring a wide range of posing possibilities for your display.
The GELGOOG Menace features movable wings, allowing the linear cannon and missiles to be positioned forward for attack stances. Its enhanced beam rifle is perfect for recreating long-range sniping actions, while the close-quarters Beam Naginata includes a grip for storage and can be conveniently mounted on the waist when not in use. A Beam Shield, utilizing polarized molding, is also included, capable of recreating both its stored and deployed states through simple parts rearrangement.
This snap-fit kit is designed for a satisfying build experience right out of the box, with detailed color-coding of parts by molding colors, minimizing the need for additional paint. It is also compatible with other Wizard Packs from the High Grade Gundam SEED or 1/144 Gundam SEED Destiny Collection Series lines, offering customization potential.

products.title: PLANNOSAURUS Tyrannosaurus Painting Ver.
products.description:
Discover the prehistoric world with the PLANNOSAURUS Tyrannosaurus Painting Ver. model kit, offering an immersive journey into dinosaur anatomy and reconstruction. This unique plastic model allows enthusiasts to build the mighty Tyrannosaurus from its skeletal structure to its outer skin, providing an educational and engaging experience.
A standout feature is the innovative material, a blend of plastic and paper powder, specifically designed to be highly receptive to paint. This allows for extensive customization, inviting you to bring your personal vision of the Tyrannosaurus to life using acrylic gouache or other household paints.
The kit features a "Skeletal Build" phase, where you construct the internal bone structure, followed by the "Dinosaur Build," which involves attaching the outer skin parts over the skeleton. This two-phase assembly provides a deeper understanding of dinosaur anatomy not typically seen in textbooks or standard models.
Assembly is straightforward and user-friendly, requiring no nippers, adhesives, or other specialized tools. The model also includes selectable parts, allowing you to reproduce the Tyrannosaurus with feathers, based on the latest paleontological theories.
Once assembled, the highly detailed model showcases the intricate structure of the Tyrannosaurus's powerful legs, characteristic teeth, and sharp claws. Its mouth can open and close, and the forelimbs, hind limbs, neck, and tail are all articulated, enabling a wide range of dynamic posing options for display.
Included in the box:
- Outer skin parts (feathers) x1 set
- Display base x1

- Manufacturer: BANDAI HOBBY

- Series: PLANNOSAURUS

products.title: 30MM 1/144 bEXM-21 VERDENOVA [NAVY]
products.description:
Introducing the 30MM 1/144 bEXM-21 VERDENOVA [NAVY], a striking addition to the 30 Minutes Missions (30MM) series from BANDAI HOBBY. This 1/144 scale model kit brings the Byron Army's inaugural flight-type unit to life, featuring a distinctive navy color scheme. Designed by the renowned mechanical designer Kanetake Ebikawa, the Verdenova offers both easy assembly for beginners and extensive customization for seasoned builders.
Experience unparalleled versatility with interchangeable head parts, allowing you to create two distinct looks for your Verdenova. By swapping antenna designs, you can even replicate three specifications: a standard unit, a special operations unit, or a commander unit, utilizing the included single-eye and twin-eye head sets.
The bEXM-21 Verdenova is engineered for dynamic posing and creative loadouts. Its two rifles can be attached to the backpack or other 3mm joints using the provided joint parts, and can be configured to reproduce High-Mobility, Long-Range Combat, or Mid-Range Combat types. The backpack and chest parts are designed to separate, forming an independent flying unit for strategic maneuvers. Two types of backpack joints are included, ensuring compatibility with a wide array of other 30MM items and allowing the flight backpack to be equipped on other units in the series.
This model kit boasts high expandability with numerous 3mm expansion ports on the main wings, ready for separately sold weapon expansion armaments from the 30MM series. A multi-joint set is also included, providing even more options for personalized customization.
Included in the box:
- Pieces to build the bEXM-21 Verdenova
- Rifle × 2
- Shield × 2
- Replacement head parts × 1 set
- Hand parts set
- Multi-joint set
- Instructions

products.title: HG 1/144 LIGHTNING BUSTER GUNDAM
products.description:
The Lightning Buster Gundam, piloted by Dearka Elthman from Mobile Suit Gundam SEED FREEDOM, joins the High Grade lineup as an impressive 1/144 scale model kit. This rendition captures the formidable mobile suit with exceptional detail and articulation, perfect for recreating iconic scenes or dynamic custom poses.
At its core, this kit incorporates the innovative SEED Action System, an internal structure specifically designed to reproduce the striking action poses seen in the Mobile Suit Gundam SEED series. The left and right connectors on the groin joint feature individual articulation, allowing for a wide range of bold and expressive stances.
The Lightning Buster Gundam's powerful arsenal is faithfully recreated. The Beam Cannon on the waist can be displayed in its deployed state using exchangeable barrel parts. Its signature large cannons are fully deployable from their folded configuration, with movable arm parts enabling them to be positioned at various angles, including over the legs and waist. For added detail, the hatches on the back open to reveal the missiles stored within. The entire body features detailed color coding, meticulously reproduced through precise parts division. This kit is also designed for compatibility with the separately sold METEOR unit, offering expanded display possibilities.
Included in the box:
- Waist beam gun parts × 2

products.title: FigLite-NUN-Valak
products.description:
From the terrifying depths of The Conjuring Universe, the demonic entity Valak, as seen in The Nun, joins your collection as a 52TOYS FIGLITE Action Figure. This collectible perfectly captures the chilling presence of Valak in her iconic nun habit, bringing a unique blend of display and interactive play to horror enthusiasts.
Experience the menacing detail of this figure, faithfully replicating Valak's sinister appearance. Customize your display with multiple interchangeable faces, allowing you to switch between expressions of eerie calm and outright horror. The poseable arms offer dynamic posing options, letting you recreate scenes of dread. Adding an element of surprise, a special wind-up mechanism allows the figure to move forward, bringing a unique sense of life to your shelf.
Key Features:
- Faithfully replicates Valak's chilling appearance in her nun habit
- Interchangeable faces for varied expressions
- Poseable arms for dynamic display
- Wind-up mechanism for forward movement
Included:
- Valak action figure

products.title: WINGMAN "WINGMAN", TAMASHII NATIONS S.H.Figuarts (SHINKOCCHOU SEIHOU)
products.description:
""Chang!"" A new character has joined the S.H.Figuarts (Shinkocchou Seihou) lineup! From the live-action series ""WING MAN"" is Kenta Hirono, who both created and transforms into the hero Wingman, now available in the Shinkocchou Seihou series! Clear parts are used for the mask's horns and the chest armor to create a look and feel similar to that of the actual suit. All of the joints throughout the body have a wide range of motion, allowing you to re-create the dynamic poses with an incredibly natural look. Soft material is used for the portion of the armor that covers the area from the ankle to the shin and also on the back, allowing for mobility without compromising the figure's shape. Included are two Chrome Raybars, the swords that he brandishes from both sides of his waist. You can also attach and remove the two Chrome Raybars in their sheathed forms. Also included are parts to re-create his Spiral-cut technique, in which he throws his horns like a boomerang.  
Another key item is the Drim Note, which led to the creation of Wingman. Even with its small size, the words in the Drim Note and the Drim Pen attached to its spine have been recreated in precise detail. The Drim Pen can be attached to and removed from the Drim Note, and there is also a hand that allows you to recreate the look of Kenta drawing out his ideas. Included is a set of exchangeable wings that can be spread out. The wings have a pearl white coloring over the clear parts to simulate the beautiful textures created by the graphics in the show. The bases of the wings are movable, enabling the figure to flap its wings as it soars freely in the sky!
[Set Contents] Main body, Exchangeable left hand x 8 types, Exchangeable right hand x 9 types, Spiral Cut exchangeable head parts set, Exchangeable wing set, Drim Note, Chrome Raybar x 2

- Manufacturer: TAMASHII NATIONS

- Series: WING MAN

products.title: Exquisite Mini Series JUDGE DREDD Hall of Heroes Judge Anderson
products.description:
A “supreme sacrifice”, a classic moment of 2000 AD history – We and Rebellion are pleased to announce the new 1/18 scale ‘Hall of
Heroes Judge Anderson’ figure set.

 ‘Judge Death’ from 2000 AD Progs 149-151 in 1980 is one of the most original and striking Judge Dredd stories, changing the course of the strip’s history. After struggling to overcome Judge Death in his murderous quest to bring his twisted ‘justice’ to the people of MegaCity One, Judge Anderson realises that the only way to stop him is to psychically cage his spirit form in her mind – and then have her body encased in the breathable but impervious ‘miracle plastic’, Boing®. Her transparent tomb, bearing the legend ‘Supreme Sacrifice. Judge Anderson – A Monster Dwells Within Her’, is housed in the ‘Hall of Heroes’ in Justice Department’s Grand Hall of Justice – considered too dangerous to ever open.

Her mind a living prison for the undead superfiend Judge Death, Judge Cassandra Anderson lies entombed in a slab of the miracle plastic Boing® – one of the most iconic moments in British comics made real in the latest in the new range of 1:18 PVC action figures based on the world of Judge Dredd, from the pages of the bestselling comic British comic, 2000 AD.

This set comes with 15 points of articulation, as well as a raft of accessories so you can recreate the drama and pathos of the conclusion to the ‘Judge Death Lives’ story from 1981, including a replacement hand, soul chip, a Boing® spray, a Boing® special effects accessory, and transparent coffin with eagle wreath.

- Manufacturer: HIYA TOYS

- Series: Live Action Movies/TV

products.title: Exquisite Mini Series 1/18 Scale STAR TREK 2009 Scotty
products.description:
We are proud to announce EXQUISITE MINI Series product comes from "Star Trek 2009" - 1/18 scale Scotty action figure.
On the day of James T. Kirk's birth, his father dies on his damaged starship in a last stand against a Romulan mining vessel looking for Ambassador Spock. 25 years later, James T. Kirk, challenged by Captain Christopher Pike to realize his potential, enrolls in Starfleet Academy, where he comes to annoy academy instructors like Commander Spock.
As the plot unfolds, Kirk encounters Scotty at a remote Federation outpost. Using the warp transport theory discovered by Scotty in the future, Spock Prime transports both Kirk and Scotty back to the Enterprise. Upon returning to the Enterprise, they employ this theory once again to successfully transport to Nero's ship, where they engage in the final battle. When the Enterprise is pulled into a black hole and unable to escape, Scotty successfully launches and detonates the warp core, aiding the Enterprise in a safe escape.
EXQUISITE MINI Series Scotty action figure stands at 105mm tall and faithfully reproduces his appearance from Star Trek 2009. He is dressed in the red shirt representing the engineer with the Starfleet emblem. Communicator, phaser pistol, and other accessories are all finely detailed, capturing the essence of his character even at the 1/18 scale. Features 17 points of articulation, provide a wider range of motion, allowing you to recreate various dynamic action poses from the movie. Includes 2x interchangeable hand parts to display different poses. A special stand to this series is also included, featuring a transparent blue base adorned with the Star Trek logo, fully immersing you in the ambiance of the Star Trek universe.

- Manufacturer: HIYA TOYS

- Series: Star Trek

products.title: Exquisite Mini 1/18 Texas Chainsaw Massacre（1974）LeatherFace - Killing Mask
products.description:
New item! Hiya Toys 1/18 Scale Texas Chainsaw Massacre 1974 Leatherface-Killing Mask now joins in Exquisite MINI Series.
The story begins with young people traveling through the wilds of rural Texas for a vacation. They stumble upon a cabin filled with human bones and eerie decorations, where they encounter a deranged butcher wearing a mask of human skin, wielding a chainsaw for merciless slaughter. Sally engages in a life-and-death struggle with the butcher and his family members while her friends are ruthlessly killed one by one, witnessing their madness and cruelty.
This new 1/18 scale Leatherface-Killing mask stands at 10.8CM, all details based on Texas Chainsaw Massacre 1974, faithfully reproduces his obese body, disheveled curly hair and his human-skin mask from the film. From the dusty leather shoes to the mud-splattered pants are all accurately depicted. Blood effects adorn the main figure and accessories are all finely painted, intensifying the sense of dread and foreboding.
In terms of accessories, comes with his iconic hammer, chainsaw, and more, with fine details even in the 1/18 scale. With 15 joints, utilizes a design supporting extensive articulation, allowing for recreations of iconic scenes. The figure also comes with a unique base, wooden floor-style base bearing the haunting traces of encounters with blood, fully immersing you in the ambiance of the most trembling atmosphere.

- Manufacturer: HIYA TOYS

- Series: Texas Chainsaw Massacre

products.title: Exquisite Mini Series 1/18 Scale The Walking Dead: Dead City Walker King
products.description:
New IP! EXQUISITE MINI Series Walker King 1/18 scale action figure from 【The Walking Dead: Dead City】 now joins Hiya Toys.
In June 2023, the sequel series【The Walking Dead: Dead City】 premiered, revealing Negan as a wanted man for killing law enforcement officers and four others. Meanwhile, Maggie's base is ravaged by the Croat, and her son Hershel is kidnapped.
To seek Negan's help, Maggie gives Ginny who is Negan's young companion a home in exchange for Maggie and Negan embarking on an adventure to Manhattan. The isolated city, bombed by the military in the virus outbreak, awaits them as an abandoned island infested with walkers.
There, they confront a formidable foe—the Walker King, a grotesque amalgamation of multiple walkers, slime, decayed fat, and other putrid substances. In a fierce battle, Maggie grapples with the monstrous entity as its mouths and arms relentlessly attack, an onslaught of nightmares closing in on her.
This brand new Walker King action figure stands 109mm tall, faithfully depicting its bloody and terrifying appearance. The upper body features extensive weathering and damage, with exposed decayed flesh at the chest and abdomen, creating a gruesome effect. Covered in scars, bloodstains, and signs of decay, every detail of the figure is perfectly reproduced even at a 1/18 scale.
With 38 articulation points throughout the body, it allows for various dynamic poses. Multiple layers of paint capture the rotten, sticky, and damp state of the Walker King. Its bloated body, incorporating other walkers within, and the emergence of a dual-headed, multiarmed form elevate the horror, showcasing its formidable malevolence.
Additionally, the figure includes a randomly selected exclusive stand from four different appearances, replicating scenes of scattered bodies remains and muddy grounds, providing an immersive experience of the most thrilling bloodbath!

- Manufacturer: HIYA TOYS

- Series: The Walking Dead

products.title: FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE™ PLAY ARTS KAI™ Action Figure TIFA LOCKHART DRESS Ver.
products.description:
Tifa, from FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE, makes her appearance in the PLAY ARTS KAI action figure line, clad in her stylish dress! We get to see another side of this martial artist, with Tifa in more formal attire. Our designers meticulously recreated every detail–from the luxurious texture of her dress, the choker-style necklace, the embellishments wrapped around her waist, all the way to her earrings. Included as accessories are interchangeable face and handpieces, as well as a hair extension to provide more movement to the figure when posing.

- Manufacturer: SQUARE ENIX

products.title: KINGDOM HEARTS III BRING ARTS™ Action Figure NAMINÉ
products.description:
Naminé, the mysterious girl from KINGDOM HEARTS III arrives as a BRING ARTS action figure!

Her light gold hair, white dress, and fair-skinned complexion, as well as her innocent and ephemeral atmosphere has been depicted in this figure. Accessories include various expressive hand parts, such as those holding a pen or a sketchbook, and two head parts; it also comes with a chair on which Naminé can sit after exchanging a body part. This package enables a variety of expressions, enabling collectors to recreate a range of scenes from the game.

Figure includes display stand.

Figure Size (inches): W 1.42” x D 0.91” x H 5.37”

- Manufacturer: SQUARE ENIX

- Series: Kingdom Hearts

products.title: NEO: The World Ends with You™ BRING ARTS™ Action Figure - RINDO
products.description:
Rindo, the protagonist of NEO: The World Ends with You, makes his appearance as a BRING ARTS figure!

On top of his lean and stylish silhouette, the texture and delicate details of his coat and pants have also been recreated. With careful attention to his hairstyle and facial expression, this figure brings out the cool air that he exudes in the game.

The figure comes with a set of parts which allow you to reenact various scenes from the game, with such accessories as unique text bubbles, three face parts with dynamic facial expressions, multiple hand parts, including one holding a smartphone, as well as coat parts with pocket openings into which Rindo can stick his hands.

In addition,  receive a free exclusive bonus item when you order from the Square Enix Store! This acrylic stand, featuring the logo from NEO: The World Ends with You, will make a great addition displayed next to Rindo.

Display stand included.

- Manufacturer: SQUARE ENIX

- Series: The World Ends with You

products.title: NieR Replicant ver.1.22474487139... BRING ARTS™ Action Figure - YOUNG PROTAGONIST
products.description:
The young protagonist from NieR Replicant ver.1.224744987139..., the updated version of NieR Replicant, joins the BRING ARTS lineup!
NieR Replicant tells the story of a brother and sister’s struggle to live in a doomed world in the distant future. The game’s graphics have become even more beautiful; and we've recreated the upgraded look with this figure. From the protagonist’s confident expression showing his inner strength, to his outfit's wrinkles and fine embellishments, we’ve taken the utmost care in showing off each individual texture in breathtaking detail.
Grimoire Weiss accompanies our protagonist, with an ornate and accurately recreated cover. This tome is fully articulated, so you can pose with it either closed or opened.
The protagonist comes equipped with a sword, which can be held with his two hands, or sheathed at his side, allowing for the protagonist to be posed in varying ways..

Display stand included.

- Manufacturer: SQUARE ENIX

- Series: NieR:Automata

products.title: FRONT MISSION STRUCTURE ARTS 1/72 Scale Plastic Model Kit Series Vol. 4 (Box)
products.description:
The fourth set in the STRUCTURE ARTS line of plastic model kits by SQUARE ENIX features ZENITH DV, HUSKY, GALBO, and MOTH designs from the FRONT MISSION franchise.

All of the FRONT MISSION STRUCTURE ARTS are designed at 1/72 scale, so they can be used in conjunction with military miniature figures and diorama displays of the same scale.

Once again, we made sure the torso, arms, lower body, backpack, and hand-held weapons are cross compatible between all the models, plus each model has a total of four hardpoints on the shoulders and arms, allowing you to attach weapons or shields. Additionally, there are utility parts included so you have the option to equip or simply carry your artillery.

Build it as-is, paint it whatever color you please, try various ways of assembly, customize the pieces to create your own original unit, and set up a diorama – with so many options to choose from, we hope you find your own way of enjoying these.

*Fully built and/or painted versions shown in the product images; assembly is required.

GOLBO
The Galbo was long favored thanks to its high durability and lightweight 
HUSKY
Developed to be used by airborne units. What it lacks in durability, it more than makes up for with its lightweight, which makes it significantly more mobile than some Wanzers.
MOTH
One of the later entries in the Cicada series, the Moth was designed with an emphasis on durability. 
ZENITH DV
A best seller Wanzer produced by Jade Metal.  The Zenith DV is compatible with the previously released Zenith and Zenith Glen Custom, thus making the parts interchangeable. (Based on FRONT MISSION 5)

Accessories: 

GALBO: one (1) extra head, two (2) knuckles, one (1) bazooka, two (2) machine guns, one (1) shield, one (1) backpack, a set of utility parts.

HUSKY: one (1) extra head, two (2) machine guns, one (1) rifle, one (1) grenade launcher, one (1) backpack, a set of utility parts.

MOTH: one (1) extra head, two (2) machine guns, one (1) pile bunke

products.title: FINAL FANTASY VII BRING ARTS™ Action Figure - CID HIGHWIND
products.description:
From FINAL FANTASY VII comes airship pilot Cid Highwind as a BRING ARTS action figure!

The figure is based on the original FINAL FANTASY VII design. With his gruffy stubble, goggles on his head, scarf around his neck, flight jacket, and more – we have faithfully recreated this nostalgic, original look of his. Our designers were meticulous about the details, as seen in the gathering of his pant hems and the shape of his boots; you can even pose him to stick his hand in his pocket by inserting his wrist into the pant pocket.

Accessories include an impressive lance taller than Cid, interchangeable faces, and interchangeable hand pieces, to allow for recreation of various scenes. 

- Manufacturer: SQUARE ENIX

- Series: Final Fantasy VII

products.title: Xenogears™ BRING ARTS™ Action Figure - BARTHOLOMEW FATIMA
products.description:
From Xenogears comes the leader of the sand pirates and the heir to the Fatima throne - Bartholomew Fatima – as a BRING ARTS action figure!

Bart’s fierce expression, golden braid, patch over his left eye, and slim but muscular physique have all been faithfully recreated. Our designers spared no effort in the details, either, as evident in the intricate decorations on the jacket, the belt on his waist, and the patterns on his boots.

His arms can be swapped out with a set that come crossed, or separate for posing, and his braid can be interchanged between one that drapes down at the front or one that flows behind his head.

Accessories include interchangeable face and hands, as well as two whips for each of his hands plus one that is coiled in a stowed position so it can be attached to the hip. The whips for each of the hands are bendable, allowing for poses with dynamic movement.

- Manufacturer: SQUARE ENIX

- Series: Video Games

products.title: KING GOMAH "DRAGON BALL DAIMA", TAMASHII NATIONS S.H.Figuarts
products.description:
Now available from S.H. Figuarts, from the anime series "Dragon Ball Daima" is King Gomah!
Despite its size of approximately 75mm in height, this figure boasts movable structure and soft parts around the abdomen that allow you to create a variety of poses, included poses with spread or crossed legs. The cape that goes over his shoulders is also made of soft material, and a movable axis at its base allow you to put him in an upward-facing pose.
Also included are exchangeable cross-arm parts so you can give him a dignified ""Gomah"" pose.
Another inclusion is a set of three exchangeable facial expressions: grinning, glaring, and clenched teeth. There are also exchangeable laughing and surprised expressions as well, so you can display the full range of Gomah's rich facial expressions.
As an added bonus, there is a set of three Power Pole Parts that you can use with the S.H. Figuarts Son Goku (Mini) Daima figure (sold separately), too! There are three types of Power Poles: 140mm-long extended Power Pole, a curved Power Pole with attached effect lines, and a spinning Power Pole with attached effect lines, so you can have fun recreating a wide range of scenes.

products.title: [KURO KARA KURI] Alteisen
products.description:
"No matter what armor… All you need is fire and pierce!"
From "Super Robot Wars OG", "Alteisen" piloted by Kyosuke Nanbu will launch an attack from Flame Toys' [KURO KARA KURI] series!
To embody in a collectible toy the concept of "a robot which is capable of swiftly breaking through enemy forces with overwhelming power" represented in the game, the figure comes with various styles of weapons and an incredible amount of detail.
The cylinder chamber of the Alteisen's signature weapon Revolving Stake in particular, can expand and bullets can be taken out!
Inside the tough and powerful form is a bold range of ultimate articulation, which allows you to enjoy not only dramatic action poses, but also a further enhanced action range while posing with the Shishioh Blade included.
This item is packed with so many charm points of Alteisen that fans of [KURO KARA KURI] series and players of "Super Robot Wars OG" can't miss to get one!

【Product Features】
・Approximately 21cm (to top of head)
・Head has LED light-up function
・Revolving Stake (right arm weapon) is the first-ever in toy history to include "case-removing" gimmick from the cylinder
・The Three-barrel Machine Cannon (left arm weapon) can connect to a soft ammunition belt part
・Panels of Square Claymore (shoulder weapon) can be opened to reveal the details of the pellet rounds
・Shishioh Blade is included and can be optionally removed from the scabbard as a handheld weapon
・Articulation range expansion gimmick and die-cast joints are designed throughout the body
・High quality spray paint work recreates each specific texture of different parts as in the original setting

- Manufacturer: FLAME TOYS

- Series: Super Robot Wars

products.title: The Simple Stand mini x4 (for Small Figures & Chibi Figures)
products.description:
Perfect stands for figures around 10cm in height! A set of 4 transparent stands. The stands work great with Nendoroid figures!

Presenting a set of 4 simple and affordable display stands! These stands, perfect for small figures around 10cm in height, feature a plain, transparent design. The support arm is equipped with a 3mm pin for connecting to holes of corresponding size. Attachable clamp-style parts and hexagonal pin parts for Nendoroid figures* are also included. The stands are made with transparent ABS resin. The diameter of each base is around 6cm. Two types of support arms—a curved type and straight type—are included. The curved support arm can be adjusted from 3 to 7cm in height, while the straight support arm can be adjusted from 4.5 to 10.7cm in height.

Clear ABS display stand. Support arms 30~107mm in height.

products.title: GH-ES-65 Edge Sharpening File ver.2.0
products.description:
Achieve razor-sharp edges and perfectly flat surfaces with the GH-ES-65 Edge Sharpening File ver.2.0. This updated version boasts improved cutting power, making your detailing work more efficient and precise. Its unique design allows for versatile use, ensuring exceptional results on your plastic models and collectibles.
This metal file features a special perforation, enabling it to cut in any direction, much like sandpaper, for unparalleled control. The wide, flat filing surface helps you quickly identify and correct even the slightest imperfections, while its lack of cushioning ensures direct, consistent filing for truly sharp edges. The revised file pattern significantly enhances cutting power, allowing you to achieve desired results in fewer passes. Its compact size ensures easy handling and precise aiming, even on surfaces connected at gentle angles.
Key Features:
- Improved cutting power with a revised file pattern
- Special perforation for multi-directional cutting, similar to sandpaper
- Wide, flat filing surface for easily spotting imperfections
- Non-cushioned design for direct and precise edge sharpening
- Compact size for comfortable handling and accurate detailing
- Effective for creating sharp edges on gently angled surfaces
Specifications:
- Material: Stainless steel (rust-resistant, but rust may occur depending on environment)
- Recommended Use: For plastics only; do not use on metals or other materials
- Maintenance: Can clog easily when sanding putty; use a toothbrush or similar tool to remove cutting dust

products.title: Voortex Airbrush Paint Mixer US
products.description:
Effortlessly achieve perfectly mixed, airbrush-ready paint in seconds with the Voortex Airbrush Paint Mixer. This automatic paint shaker utilizes high-speed vortex mixing to thoroughly blend settled pigments, ensuring consistent flow and reliable atomization for every spray. It's designed for speed, silent operation, and hands-free convenience, allowing you to focus on your hobby.
Experience a whisper-quiet workspace thanks to its low-noise brushless motor and dual-layer vibration-damping housing. The Voortex features a secure locking mechanism that firmly holds your paint bottle in place during high-speed spinning, with a self-stabilizing core that dampens movement. Its flexible stepped holder is designed for universal bottle fit, accommodating diameters from 25 mm to 50 mm (10 ml to 60 ml bottles), and heights from 35 mm to 125 mm, keeping various container styles locked in place without slipping.
Equipped with three dedicated speed modes, you can precisely match the mixing intensity to different paint thicknesses, from gentle blending to high-intensity separation for stubborn pigments. The high-performance brushless motor reaches top speeds of up to 3,500 RPM, quickly dissolving heavy metallics and dried separation in just 2 to 3 minutes. An intuitive visual progress display, combining a clear digital countdown timer with a dynamic LED ring, provides real-time speed and remaining time feedback. A heavy-duty silicone base firmly anchors the device to your workbench, absorbing vibrations and reducing desk resonance.
Included:
- Voortex Airbrush Paint Mixer unit
- Power cable
Specifications:
- Model: Voortex
- Rated Power: 10W
- Max Speed: 3500RPM
- Power Adjustment: 3 Levels Adjustable
- Product Dimensions: 106 x 95 x 117 mm
- Compatible Bottle Height: 35 - 125mm

- Input: DC 5V 2.0A

products.title: MODEROID Gatcha Spartan Unite Color Ver.
products.description:
Gatcha Spartan Unite Color!
From the popular science fiction anime "Gatchaman Fighter" comes a new exclusive version of the MODEROID plastic model of the Science Ninja Team's high speed aircraft, Gatcha Spartan!

• The impressive model is approximately 330mm in length. The model allows for transformation and combination of the 5 mechs. When combining, the use of interchangeable front wheel parts for G-2 and additional support parts for the tip of G-3 are required.

• Red and white tip parts for G-1 are included, allowing for display options with either color.
• A ready-to-assemble Ken Washio, the Eagle (unpainted, adhesive required) wielding the Gatchaman Fencer in the same scale is also included.
• Hypershoot mode can be recreated by standing Ken Washio, the Eagle on top of the aircraft.
• A base featuring the Science Ninja Team's Bird mark motif is also included, allowing the model to be displayed mid-flight. The base of the figure has been redesigned with a translucent color inspired by the Hypershoot effect.
• The various parts of the mecha have been separated into different colored runners, pre-painted parts and stickers, making it easy to recreate the mecha with a simple assembly.

[Specifications]

products.title: MODEROID TYPE97 TFV-EX Crab-Man High Leg
products.description:
The land-clearing Labor with built-in auto-balancing systems is finally available in plastic model kit form!

The TYPE97 TFV-EX Crab-Man High Leg joins the continuously expanding series of MODEROID plastic models from "Mobile Police Patlabor"!

1/60 scale plastic model kit. · The model stands at about 170mm in height. Joints of the model are articulated.

Its four legs are individually movable, allowing you to create all kinds of poses from the anime series.

The model is equipped with wheel parts to create its running state.

Blinkers, front lights, cameras, etc. are created with translucent parts.

The parts of the Labor have been separated into various colored runners and pre-painted parts, and the model kit also comes with stickers, making it easy to recreate the Labor from the series with a simple assembly.

- Manufacturer: GOOD SMILE COMPANY

- Series: Mobile Police Patlabor

products.title: MODEROID El Dora V
products.description:
"Let's go! El Dorado!"

The El Dora V from "Gun x Sword" is making its plastic model debut in the MODEROID series!

The model stands at about 200mm in height. Joints of the model are articulated. All five mecha—Grand Header, Body Gander, Power Hander, Nice Footer and Pink Amigo—can be combined to create El Dora V!

Interchangeable parts for Body Gander's head and Pink Amigo's wings are included to create a look even closer to the anime series.

Combine all four mecha besides Pink Amigo and attach the dedicated head part to create El Dora IV!

Dedicated parts to create the El Dora Fist and El Dora V Ultimate are included.

The chest missile Bombardier is also included. It can be attached to the alternate Body Gander head part.

The various parts of the mecha have been separated into different colored runners, pre-painted parts and stickers, making it easy to recreate the ships with a simple assembly.

*Product photos updated on the 21st of February, 2023.

https://www.mechasmile.com/moderoid_eldora_v/en/

- Manufacturer: GOOD SMILE COMPANY

- Series: Gun x Sword

products.title: Nendoroid Doll archetype 1.1: Girl (Cinnamon)
products.description:
The base body of a Nendoroid Doll. Enjoy more ways to play with your Nendoroids! Introducing a new body for your Nendoroid dolls! The Nendoroid Doll series of palm-sized action figures feature the same heads as standard Nendoroids, but alternate doll-like bodies that are highly articulated and can easily be dressed up into different outfits! The feet of the Nendoroid Doll body feature magnets in the soles of the feet which allow for easy posing on the included magnetic base, but an articulated stand is also included allowing for more active poses! A longer neck joint is included which can be used for a better appearance when using certain fabric outfits. You can easily attach the head parts of previously released Nendoroids to give your favorite characters a whole new set of display possibilities!

- Manufacturer: GOOD SMILE COMPANY

- Series: No Series

products.title: Rika Furude: Night Pool ver.
products.description:
"Let's party, nano desu." From "Higurashi: When They Cry - SOTSU" comes a "Night Pool ver." scale figure of Rika Furude! Rika's white school swimsuit and summerlike straw hat work to draw out Rika's cute and mysterious charm. The use of neon colors throughout the figure sets the atmosphere of a pool at night. The pool ring made with translucent parts, beach ball decorated with illustrations of Hanyu and figure base made to look as though it is lit-up have all been carefully created.

- Manufacturer: Miyuki

- Series: Higurashi: When They Cry GOU

products.title: MAIDMADE Shinobu Oshino
products.description:
The MAIDMADE series begins! Presenting a figure of Shinobu Oshino in an original maid outfit!

From "Zoku Owarimonogatari", the latest entry in the Monogatari series, comes a scale figure of Shinobu Oshino in an original maid outfit!
Her maid outfit is made with detailed paintwork that brings out the individual textures of the fabrics and belts.

Her condescending gaze, slightly visible fangs, dynamic pose, beautiful long hair, chain and other finely sculpted details make this figure a must-see! The sword, Kokorowatari, is an impressive 20cm long. Be sure to add this figure of Shinobu—a mixture of cuteness, mystique and audacity—to your collection!

What is MAIDMADE?
MAIDMADE is a new project based on the concept of original maid costumes and beautiful girls by figure manufacturer Miyuki. Sometimes dainty, sometimes cool—stay tuned for more high-quality MAIDMADE figures of beautiful girls loved around the world!

- Manufacturer: Miyuki

- Series: Monogatari Series

products.description:
"There is hope. There is always hope."

The Parfom action figure series co-developed with garage kit dealer 'RyunRyunTei' Ryuntaro is back as the brand-new "Parfom R!" series, featuring even more articulation than before! The fifth figure to join the series is Kaworu Nagisa from the Rebuild of Evangelion movies in his plugsuit.

He comes with three face plates including a front-facing expression, a smiling expression and another smiling expression looking to the left. He also comes with the Spear of Cassius as an optional part that he can be posed holding.

- Manufacturer: Phat! Company

- Series: Rebuild of Evangelion

products.title: Parfom R! Evangelion Unit-02
products.description:
EVA02 is lifting off in the Parfom series!

The Parfom action figure series co-developed with garage kit dealer 'RyunRyunTei' Ryuntaro is back as the brand-new "Parfom R!" series, featuring even more articulation than before! The sixth figure to join the series is Evangelion Unit-02 from the Rebuild of Evangelion series of movies! The figure comes with two Pallet Rifles, two Progressive Knifes and a Thunder Spear featuring a foldable tip. The Umbilical Cable that attaches to the back can even be adjusted to be used as an alternative stand! Be sure to display with Parfom Evangelion Unit-01 (sold separately)!

- Manufacturer: Phat! Company

- Series: Rebuild of Evangelion

products.title: DP-12: Echeveria Lantern -Crimson-
products.description:
"I'm sorry, but I can carry on any longer... You'll forgive me, right?"

From the popular smartphone game "Girls' Frontline" comes a 1/6 scale figure of the Shotgun T-Doll DP-12! She's been brought into figure form based on the heavily damaged appearance of her outfit from the 2020 Lunar New Year event. This version features a special color scheme.

DP-12's alluring expression and pose as though inviting the viewer closer and her boldly exposed skin, further emphasized due to the damage she's sustained, have been faithfully captured in figure form. The gorgeous designs of her outfit have been recreated as well. Of course, her ever-important weapon and drone have been brought into figure form too.

An LED light can be installed into the lantern held by the drone, making for an even more atmospheric display.

Painted 1/6 scale plastic figure with stand included. Approximately 130mm in height (excluding base).

- Manufacturer: Phat! Company

- Series: Girls' Frontline

products.title: Rikka Takarada(re-run)
products.description:
"I don't understand what Gridman is..."

From the anime series "SSSS.GRIDMAN" comes a rerelease of the scale figure of the cool, composed and somewhat listless heroine, Rikka Takarada!
She's been recreated in a pose looking over her shoulder with a gentle smile on her face.
Her trademark long cardigan and gorgeous legs have been sculpted in meticulous detail to bring out Rikka's unique charm. Be sure to add her to your collection!

- Manufacturer: Phat! Company

- Series: SSSS.GRIDMAN

products.title: Ryza: Chinese Dress Ver.
products.description:
Ryza in a Chinese dress outfit, now as a scale figure!

From "Atelier Ryza 2: Lost Legends & the Secret Fairy" comes a 1/6 scale figure of the protagonist Reisalin Stout, also known as Ryza, in a Chinese dress outfit!
The figure features Ryza in a black Chinese dress outfit, beautifully styled with a special hairstyle! Visual highlights include her lively smile, her shapely leg peeking out from the high slit of her dress, as well as the Puni-shaped steamed bun in her hand.

Painted plastic 1/6 scale complete product with base included. Approximately 280mm in height.

- Manufacturer: Phat! Company

- Series: Atelier Ryza

products.title: Makima
products.description:
Presenting a scale figure of Makima, leader of Public Safety Special Division 4!

From the anime series "Chainsaw Man" comes a 1/7 scale figure of the devil hunter that reports directly to the Chief Cabinet Secretary, Makima!
Makima has been captured in figure form sitting atop the ruins of a brick wall with a gentle smile on her face.
Makima's mysterious expression that conveys an air of kindness with a sense of terror concealed within, her clean uniform, fluttering coat, braided hair and the bright graffiti on the wall that seems to contradict the overall atmosphere of the figure have been created in incredible detail.

- Manufacturer: Phat! Company

- Series: Chainsaw Man

A funny sweet-style antique chair.

The fifth item in the doll series is a new color of the well-received third item in the series, an antique chair! The chair features a frame inspired by milk chocolate with a strawberry chocolate and heart-themed pink seat.
The seat cushion of the chair can also be removed, allowing you to use the chair as a small storage case. A luxurious "Indigo" chair is also available for preorder from the same time. Be sure to add one to your collection!

products.title: figma JSDF Soldier
products.description:
Realistic military action figures are coming to the figma series!

From the 1/2 scale model weapon series "Little Armory" comes new realisitic military figma action figures!
The first in the series is Japan's Self-Defense Force. The figma is based on the Ground Self-Defense Force Infantry of the 2000s.

· Pad printing is used to create the unique camouflage pattern of the Japan Ground Self-Defense Force. The printing pad is applied over 200 times to create the uniform.
· With the aim of capturing the appeal of a single nameless soldier, the face plate of the figure is made with sunglasses.
· The neck features articulation in two spots, allowing you to display the figure holding its included rifle in an even more realistic way.
· By creating kneepads as separate parts and adding double-joint articulation to the knees and shoulders, it is possible to create all kinds of military poses.
· Two types of Type 89 rifles are included: a ready-to-use complete product and a plastic model kit version that places more emphasis on detailed modeling.
· A 9mm handgun that can be stored in the included holster is included.
· A flexible plastic is used for important areas, allowing proportions to be kept without compromising posability.
· Using the smooth yet posable joints of figma, you can create a variety of poses.
· An articulated figma stand is included to display the figma in a variety of poses.


Check out the other　Japan Self-Defense Force equipment miniatures made by Little Armory! Little Armory WEB: http://www.littlearmory.jp/

- Manufacturer: TOMYTEC

- Series: Little Armory

This set is a bare hands version of figma Tactical Gloves 2. The set is made to display your figures holding handguns, rifles and P90 type weapons. The set includes a combined left and right hand part for displaying your figma holding a handgun with both hands, hand parts for displaying your figma holding guns with angled grips and more, making it easy to display your figma with a wide variety of guns when paired with one of the previous handsets. The set also comes with runners for creating two large pistols. Enjoy pairing with your Little Armory figma figures, figma Styles figures and more! * Parts are sold as a connected plastic kit. Parts require no assembly but do require tools to be cut apart. * The Little Armory weapons and figma figures are not included. This kit includes the hand parts only. See below for more information about the Little Armory series! (Japanese) LittleArmory WEB: http://www.littlearmory.jp/

products.title: [C3] 1:72 MITSUBISHI F-1
products.description:
三菱F-1は、練習機型T-2から発達した航空自衛隊の支援戦闘機です。
国産初の超音速ジェット戦闘機として、
昭和47年に開発を始め昭和50年度より調達を開始しました。
過去に支援戦闘機としてF-86Fが使用されていましたが、
本格的な支援戦闘機運用を行うため航空自衛隊は
F-5EタイガーIIの導入も考えられましたが、
当時運用段階にあったT-2練習機の戦闘機改造案に決定しました。

 

FS-T2改（後のF-1）の開発がスタートし、
このためT-2の量産型106号機と107号機が飛行試験用にT-2特別仕様機として完成し、
各種のシステム試験や飛行試験を行いました。
これら各種試験の結果に基づき昭和51年11月14日付で防衛庁長官の部隊使用承認が下り、
同時にFS-T2改から支援戦闘機F-1に正式名称が決定されました。
F-1配備は52年度から開始され三沢基地の第3飛行隊、第8飛行隊、
築城基地の第6飛行隊に順次F-86Fに替えて配備されました。

 

F-1は支援戦闘機ですが運用上要撃戦闘機としても使用されます。
このため武装は多種装着されます。
要撃ミッション時は空対空ミサイルサイドワインダー、
支援戦闘時は500lb爆弾、対艦ミサイル、70mmまたは127mmロケット弾等を装着します。
こうした多種ミッションを行うためF-1はT-2から改造される際に、
捜索追尾レーダーの強化、電波高度計と大気諸元計算機を追加装備、
レーダー警戒装置、ストライクカメラ等を装着し、
武装関係の取付けパイロン等追加改造を行っています。

 

このような改造、追加装備の中、F-1の特徴的装備として
J/AWG-12レーダーとJ/ASQ-1管制計算機があります。
この装置は正確な爆撃を行うための重要な装置です。
レーダー、ヘッドアップ・ディスプレイ（HUD）、慣性航法装置、電波高度計、
大気諸元計算機等からの情報を計算し最適な情報をHUDとレーダーに出力します。
またこの装置には自動モードがあり、HUDに弾着地点とそこまでの飛行経路を投影し、
パイロットが投弾操作をすると最適な投弾時期を計算し自動的に投弾されます。

 

F-1は生産途中の昭和58年度より自動操縦装置が装着されるようになり、
それまでの機体にも定期修理の際取付けられるようになりました。
これによりパイロットの負担は少く確実な攻撃任務が行えるようになりました。
またミッションの性格上超低空飛行することが多く、
鳥との衝突が問題になっていましたが、固定風防を頑丈なポリカーボネイト製にして
フレームをなくしたワンピースキャノピーにすることで解決しました。

products.title: [C4] 1:72 MITSUBISHI T-2
products.description:
三菱T-2は、航空自衛隊の超音速練習機です。
当時航空自衛隊はF-104Jの配備、F-4EJの導入決定など
それまでのF-86Fに比べ格段の飛行性能を持った航空機が主流になりつつありました。
このためそれらに搭乗するパイロットの教育が問題になりました。
このため航空自衛隊は、新たな超音速ジェット練習機の導入をすることになりました。
当初は 当時アメリカ空軍が使用していたT-38か
新たに国内開発をするか検討されましたが、国内開発に決定されました。

 

防衛庁技術研究本部は国内航空機メーカーに仕様を提出し
1967年9月に三菱重工を主契約者とし、
他社も生産に協力する形でX-T計画がスタートしました。
X-T計画は、復座の双発練習機計画ですが大きな特徴として
同時に支援戦闘機（FS-X）に発展できるということが最初から求められていました。
1968年3月XT-2計画は試作に関する第1次計画が結ばれ、
1969年4月モックアップが完成しました。
その後、試作1号機は、1971年4月23日にロールアウト、
同年7月20日初飛行を行いました。

 

T-2の機体概要は、復座、双発でエンジンはイギリスの
ロールスロイス社製チュルボメカ・アドーアMk801Aアフターバーナー付きで
最大推力は3,310kgです。主翼は高翼式で9度の下反角を持ったクリップドデルタ翼で、
最大の特徴は横方向コントロールをエルロンをやめてスポイラーに変更した点です。
これは、主翼フラップの面積が大きく取れることを考慮したものです。
超音速機の難関の一つである空気取り入れ口は
周囲に6箇所の補助空気取り入れ口を設けた固定ランプ式です。
固定武装はM61A-1バルカン砲を搭載します。
また、搭載レーダーは三菱電機が開発した国産のJ/AWG-11レーダーFCSを搭載していますが
これらは、戦闘機操縦基礎課程で使用されるT-2前期型には搭載されていません。

 

T-2練習機は、上記の通り前期型、後期型の2機種がありました。
T-33Aで基本操縦課程を終了しウィングマークを取得した学生は
松島基地で戦闘操縦基礎課程に入ります。このとき使用されるのがT-2前期型で、
学生はT-2による超音速飛行や操縦に関する基礎知識を学びます。
これを終了した学生は次の戦闘操縦課程に進みます。
このとき使用されるT-2後期型は、レーダー、バルカン砲を装備した機体で
射撃など戦闘機の操縦運用を学び、これを卒業した学生パイロットは
各実戦部隊に配属されていきました。
1975年松島基地に配備されたT-2は30年近く学生訓練に使用されてきましたが、
2004年に後継をF-2Bに譲り訓練飛行から引退しました。

- Manufacturer: Hasegawa

- Series: No Series

products.title: [D11] 1:72 KAWASAKI T-4 BLUE IMPULSE
products.description:
1958年10月19日浜松北基地にて行われた航空祭で
3機のF-86Fが曲技飛行を行ったのが現在のブルーインパルスの始まりです。

 

航空自衛隊は1960年4月16日に浜松基地第1航空団に空中機動研究班を発足、
天竜の名でF-86Fセイバーを使用した曲技飛行チームができました。
F-86Fを使用したこのチームは後に、コールサインのインパルスブルーを使用した
ブルーインパルスとチーム名称を変更し、
オリンピックの五輪、万博のEXPO'70を空中に描き世界中に名を知らしめました。

 

この後数多くの曲技飛行を日本全国で行ってきましたが、
1982年のシーズンから老朽化したF-86Fに代わり
国産ジェット練習機T-2にバトンタッチしました。
T-2によるスピーディーな曲技飛行は多くのファンを魅了しました。
F-86F、T-2を使用してきたブルーインパルスチームは、
1996年のシーズンより最新型の純国産ジェット練習機T-4に変更して現在に至っています。

 

F-15並の空中機動が可能なT-4は、より高度で小気味よい演技を我々観客に披露しています。

products.title: [E12] 1:72 F-15J EAGLE J.A.S.D.F.
products.description:
F-15Jイーグルは、航空自衛隊の主力要撃戦闘機です。
日本の航空自衛隊はアメリカ空軍、イスラエルに続く世界で3番目のイーグル装備国です。
それまでF-104Jを要撃戦闘機として使用してきた航空自衛隊は、
F-104Jの後継機としてF-Xを調査しました。
多くの候補機の中から昭和51年12月9日にF-15を採用することが決定、
昭和56年3月27日に第1号機が岐阜基地に到着しました。

 

導入当初の航空自衛隊のF-15Jは
基本的にアメリカ空軍のF-15Cブロック26に相当する機体で、
一部航空自衛隊独自の改修を行っていました。
これは、自衛隊独自の自動警戒管制組織（バッジ・システム）と
E-2C早期警戒機からの要撃管制を受ける
高速データ装置（J/ASW-10データリンクシステム）が追加されたのと
垂直尾翼の先端のアンテナをマスバランスに変更したのが主な改修点です。

 

航空自衛隊はF-15Jを最初、新田原基地に配備し
パイロットの育成に当てたあと本格的に戦闘航空団に配備を開始しました。
現在Ｆ-15Jは201飛行隊（千歳基地）、202飛行隊（新田原基地）、
203飛行隊（千歳基地）、204飛行隊（百里基地）、303飛行隊（小松基地）、
304飛行隊（築城基地）、305飛行隊（百里基地）の7個飛行隊に配備されています。

 

F-15Jはアメリカ空軍と同様、多段階改良計画（MSIP）を行っており
年々装備品が改良追加装備されています。
このため新たにアンテナが追加されたりと、外観上でも変化しています。
この他、国産の空対空ミサイルAAM-3を搭載できる機体も改修中です。
F-15Jは航空自衛隊の主力戦闘機として
今後開発されるFS-Xとともに日本の空の防衛に活躍していきます。

products.title: [JT79] 1:48 SPITFIRE Mk.IXc
products.description:
ドイツ空軍の高々度爆撃機に対して開発された
高々度戦闘機であるスピットファイアMk.VI、Mk.VIIでしたが、
恐れていた敵爆撃機の侵入がなかったため、
必要なくなった与圧キャビンを取り外し
通常の戦闘機型にしたのがスピットファイアMk.VIIIでした。

 

しかし、量産が遅れたため、
ドイツ空軍のFw109Aに対抗するために、
Mk.VIIIに代わって登場したのが、Mk.IXでした。

 

Mk.IXは既存のMk.Vcの機体に最小限の改良と、
マーリン61エンジンを搭載し、1942年6月に量産1号機が完成し、
1945年6月までに各型合計5,600機ほどが生産され、
主力はマーリン66エンジン装備の低高度用(LF)で、
次にマリーン61または63エンジンの中高度用(F)が千数百機、
マーリン70の高々度用(HF)が600機弱でした。

 

当初、武装はCウィングが主でしたが、
後に20mm機関砲×2、12.7mm機銃×2装備のEウィングも採用され、
主翼は標準翼と切断翼が用いられ、
後期生産機では、方向舵が大型化されました。

 

また、Mk.IXの大量生産によるエンジンの供給不足を補うため、
マーリン66と基本的に同じ、
アメリカでライセンス生産のパッカード・マーリン266を搭載した、
外観及び性能はMk.IXと同じMk.XVIが1,000機ほど生産されました。

 

《データ》

出力：1,580hp

products.title: [JT19] 1:48 SBD-3 DAUNTLESS
products.description:
SBDドーントレスの基本設計は
ノースロップ社エルセグント工場で行われました。
エルセグント工場がダグラス社に売却されると、
開発を進めていたXBT-2はXSBD-1と改称され、
開発は引き継がれてSBDドーントレスの基礎となりました。

 

1939年4月には量産が開始され
海兵隊用にSBD-1が57機、海軍用のSBD-2が87機量産されました。

 

SBD-3はフランス降伏後に174機の量産が発注され、
ヨーロッパでの戦訓を取り入れ多くの改良が実施されました。
エンジンは馬力こそ変わりませんが、
改良されたR-1820-52に換装されました。
また、乗員と燃料タンクに対する防弾対策の強化も行われ、
防弾鋼板の強化と防弾タンクが全面的に採用されました。
武装も、機首の固定銃が7.7mm機銃2丁から12.7mm機銃2丁に強化され、
後席の7.7mm旋回機銃も2連装になりました。
その他にも電気系統をいままでの12Vから24Vに強化したり、
機首の空気取入れ口を低くして前方視界を良くする等の改修もされました。
これらの改修のため機体重量が増加し最高速度が低下しています。
それでも日米開戦後には500機が追加発注され、
SBD-3は合計584機生産されました。
これらの機体はミッドウェイ海鮮や珊瑚海海戦に活躍しました。

 

1942年10月から引渡しが開始されたSBD-4では
無線航法支援装置や初歩的な空中レーダーを装備したので
実戦での能力はSBD-3に比べ大幅に向上しました。
ほかにも燃料ポンプは電動式のものが1個追加され、
さらに緊急用のものも1個付けられました。
また、プロペラがいままでの定速式のものから
ハミルトン・スタンダード・ハイドロマチック恒速式になったので
エンジンのパワーを効率良く使えるようになりました。
SBD-4はSBD-3よりも多く、780機生産されました。

 

この後ドーントレスは5型、6型と続き、陸軍にもA-24として採用され、
アメリカの急降下爆撃機として、一時代を築いただけでなく、
その低翼単葉で引き込み式の主脚を持ち、乗員をタンデムに配置した機体レイアウトは
その後に設計されたプロペラ付き急降下爆撃機に多く影響を与えました。

products.title: [JT36] 1:48 NAKAJIMA Ki-44-II HEI SHOKI (TOJO)
products.description:
昭和13年、用兵思想が軽戦格闘主義から
高速一撃離脱戦法へと移行したころ陸軍では、
軽戦のキ-43の試作発令とほぼ同時期に、
速度、上昇力、急降下性能などを重視した
高速重戦闘機キ-44の試作指示を中島に発令しました。

 

中島では陸軍の要求を満足させるため
大出力のエンジンを選び直径は大きいが、
当時最大の出力を持ったハ-41に決定、
これにより機首は太くなり
主翼は高速化のため翼面積をけたはずれに小さくし、
主翼後縁には中島独特の蝶型フラップを採用して
空戦時及び離着陸時の性能を高めました。

 

テストの結果、離着陸時の視界不良や低速時の安定性の悪さに、
九七式戦闘機の慣れたパイロットは戸惑い評判はよくありませんでした。
しかし、Bf-109Eや川崎キ-60との性能比較では、
キ-44の方が優れていたため、
昭和17年に二式単座戦闘機として制式採用され
後に通称を"鍾馗"と命名しました。

 

ハ-41を装備した機体は二式単座戦闘機一型、
さらに強力なエンジンハ-109を搭載した機体は
二式単座戦闘機ニ型と区別しました。
また、ニ型には武装、装備の違いにより甲、乙、丙があり、
昭和15年～昭和19年の間に各型合わせて1,227機生産され、
防空任務について敵爆撃機の迎撃に活躍しました。

products.title: [CW08] 1:1500 Space Pirate Battleship ARCADIA Second Ship (PHANTOM DEATH SHADOW conversion)

スペースバスター（速射砲）も上 下方向に可動。
艦首のラムは部品の差替えにより再現。
付属の展示用スタンドは支柱部分にトチローの墓標をイメージしたデザインを採用。
成形色は、ブルー、ダークブルー、ブラック、ホワイト、
レッド、ブラウン、クリアーイエローの7色の予定。

 

ボーナスパーツとして、同スケールの艦載機「コスモウイング」が２機付属。
艦首や船尾楼のレリーフ彫刻に対応したデカールが付属。

生産の都合により、再生産のスケジュールが変更となりました。
弊社発送日は2021年9月24日となります。

One of Agnirage’s primary weapons is a long-range, chargeable beam known as the “Imperial Flame.” The powerful weapon is used by Agnirage to defend the Crystal Reactors from attackers by burning them to ash by harnessing the “flames of hell.”

Upon sensing enemy forces in its vicinity, Agnirage will immediately take off and fire the Imperial Flame at the enemy attackers from high in the sky. 
After unleashing total devastation on the enemy targets, which often lack defense from aerial attacks, Agnirage will deploy drones to take out the remaining enemies.

In order to accommodate the unit’s inferior armor defense in close-range land battles, Agnirage is equipped with a defense force field, allowing it to stave off attacks from the enemy’s foot soldiers. 
Agnirage units are typically used individually or in small groups in order to conquer enemy forces over a wide area with rapid precision, and are considered to be one of the biggest threats to the Liberty Alliance along with Para-Pawn Expander.

The exact timeline for the unit’s development is unknown. The unit’s existence was unknown until the initial attacks on the Crystal Reactors, and it is said that the unit already existed at the time of Demolition Brute’s appearance.

Lord Impulse is a third generation Hexa Gear developed by Earthcline Biomechanics.

The tip of the arm is equipped with an adjustable claw. This weapon can be used as a fifth arm in close quarters combat, tearing enemy Governors from machines when passing by at high speed.
The arm can also hold firearms or melee weapons. With the trick blade’s sturdy construction under the Zoatex control system, the weapon becomes both resilient and swift, surpassing the range and utility of Voltrex’s tail blade.

Model Information:
ARMOR TYPE: KNIGHT

The aim of this project was to develop a new type of armor based on Pawn A1 that would be more specialized for mounted warfare. The idea was to raise the combat capabilities of third-gen HEXA GEAR by having Governors take a more direct role in combat.

Almost all of the top priority design changes were oriented around mounted combat using third-gen HEXA GEAR's open cockpit design. This dramatically improved the survivability of Governors who would otherwise be continually exposed to fire.
The heavy armoring of the body is concentrated on key torso parts. No major changes were made to the limbs, other than the knees and some other protruding parts, in order to maintain mobility when boarding HEXA GEAR.
The power assistance of the artificial muscles in the inner suit were also greatly improved. This was done with the awareness that energy supplies from the HEXA G-R.A.M would be excessively depleted and the machine’s operating time would be shortened, but receiving a higher power output in return. The underlying aim was to improve combat capability with heavy weapons, which Pawn A1 was unable to handle.
This system is conceptually similar to the ""resonant energization"" of Rayblade Impulse and was carried over into the subsequent research on EX ARMOR TYPES by the Hakua Riken Research Institute.

In addition, a major change from Pawn A1 was the addition of a mounting arm. The arm serves as both an extension platform and power assistance and comes standard with the unit. The structure of the unit allows it to be divided or changed for flexible use. Naturally, it is also compatible with other ARMOR TYPES and is able to suspend equipment when used in combination with the KARMA control system, including heavy weapons such as shields and charge cannons, which would normally be placed on board.

Armor Type is a name for reinforced armored suits for Governors. It is a sealed work suit with armored exterior and artificial muscles used to withstand extreme environments. It still has a life-support system installed as conventional suits did, enabling it to operate for extended periods of time in contaminated areas such as around a Crystal Reactor.

Pawn A1 was developed based on the concept of ""man-machine oneness"" and has gained strength to be able to fight alongside Hexa Gear in Zoatex mode.
As specs of Hexa Gear became more focused on agility than having heavy armor, Governors also went through changes in response to keep up with the machines using physical enhancements and building toughness. Governors must be soldiers who fight alongside the machine–not just a normal pilot.

products.title: DEFINITION ARMOR “BLAZEBOAR”
products.description:
The Definition Armor was a lightweight, highly mobile exoskeleton for infantry that was created to wreak havoc on the battlefield. The concept was based on two previously successful HEXA GEAR, with tweaks made to their designs—the first being a downsized version of the bipedal humanoid heavy HEXA GEAR, BULKARM α, and the second being the renowned SCARECROW with elements simplified to allow the rider to wear the armor instead of riding it. However, an early prototype that was tested on a real battlefield lacked balance due to the overuse of various elements. The armor thus became infamous as a ""cutting-edge walking coffin."" However, the armor did excel at one aspect: its ability to be mass-manufactured. Thus, to achieve practical application, various alterations and refinements to the design were considered. The only plans that eventually made it to production were the WOODPECKER, a unit that lent itself to the armor's lightweight and high-speed capabilities, and this BLAZEBOAR, which realized a downsized version of BULKARM as the design had originally intended. 

The core components of BLAZEBOAR are largely the same as those of the WOODPECKER developed around the same time. However, BLAZEBOAR utilizes sensors in the center of the upper torso to provide a wider field of view to the left and right to compensate for its reduced maneuverability. The large legs serve as armor that protects the lower body of the Governor and the arms, which are equipped with heavy weapons, act as side armor. The thruster is designed to be smaller and less powerful than the WOODPECKER to reduce the weight of the unit and allow it to deploy alongside walking infantry units. In addition to the master-slave system, control of the armor is assisted by the G2AI, an AI system that uses data from the BMI installed in the Governor's standard issue WARMAGE to ensure the stable control of both the unit and its armaments.

IGNITE SPARTAN is a PARA-PAWN developed and manufactured by MSG. 
This is the latest model of the Ignite, which was originally developed as a cavalry unit based on the general-purpose Sentinel. As the majority of parts have been newly manufactured, it offers an improved balance of parts as well as higher performance than its predecessor.

In particular, the load capacity of the legs has been greatly increased, making it possible to carry heavier and larger equipment. Additionally, a new type of universal arm has been developed for the operation of this larger equipment. By placing it on the back, the load on the arms and motion restrictions have been eliminated. These features free up the unit's arms for firearms and other weapons while simultaneously being able to carry the large equipment on its back, making it easier to march into battle alone than the Ignite.

The increased load capacity also contributes to its defensive capabilities, which can be seen in the improved new chest and shoulder armor. Specifically, the chest has a larger collar that serves to protect the neck.
The replacement of almost the entire body with newly manufactured parts has resulted in the loss of nearly all common parts with the Para-Pawn Sentinel, and significantly impacted mass production and maintainability. However, creating unit formations centered around Ignite Spartan units has proven to provide a similar rate of operation. 

As standard, the unit comes equipped with a large spear-like weapon called the ""Colossal Lance."" The head of the lance is so long that it requires a folding mechanism to carry and was designed specifically for use by third-gen HEXA GEAR. Its offensive capabilities were also designed entirely with use against HEXA GEAR in mind.

products.title: BATMAN: THE KILLING JOKE THE JOKER ARTFX STATUE
products.description:
Capture the definitive moment of madness from the legendary 1988 graphic novel with this striking 1/6 scale rendition of the Clown Prince of Crime. This statue brings to life the unforgettable sequence where a cornered Red Hood Gang member emerges from the chemical-laden waters of the Ace Chemical Processing Plant, transformed forever into the Joker.

The sculpt depicts the character at his most vulnerable and volatile, stumbling to his feet as he realizes the permanent changes to his skin and hair. Every detail of his frantic expression and the harrowing laugh that follows is meticulously rendered to honor the source material. The coloring is specifically inspired by the 20th anniversary edition of the graphic novel, which featured a distinct palette recolored by the original artist to emphasize the dark, atmospheric tone of the story.

Standing nearly 12 inches tall, the figure is positioned on a specialized display base designed to evoke the riverbank where the transformation occurred. The base features realistic textures including gravel and rain droplets, grounding the character in the specific environment of his "one bad day."

- Highly detailed 1/6 scale statue based on the Batman: The Killing Joke graphic novel
- Sculpted by Keita Misonou to capture the character's transition into madness
- Paint application inspired by the 20th anniversary monochrome-style recoloring
- Includes a custom environmental base with gravel and rain effects
- Ready for display straight out of the box

Specifications
- Scale: 1/6
- Height: Approximately 300mm (11.81 inches)
- Material: PVC (Phthalate-free), ABS
- Series: DC Comics ARTFX
- Brand: Kotobukiya

- Manufacturer: KOTOBUKIYA

Step into the immersive world of KOF, where content can be enjoyed on consoles, smartphones, and PCs by adding this figure to your collection!

products.title: ARTFX 1/7 DARTH MAUL™
products.description:
This notice is an announcement regarding ARTFX DARTH MAUL™ (February 2024 Release) that is currently available for pre-order. We would like to announce that we will be including a first production-only bonus item with this product. The bonus item is a base part for the currently available ARTFX AHSOKA TANO™ Escape from the Clones. By switching out the base for Ahsoka Tano™ and connecting it with the base for Darth Maul™, you can have them face off against each other just like their battle scene from the series. Recreate the excitement of The Clone Wars™ by adding Darth Maul™ to your collection!
"Every choice you have made has led you to this moment” From the acclaimed animated series Star Wars: The Clone Wars™ on Disney+ emerges a familiar face from the shadows of the dark side of the Force - Darth Maul™! Rebuilt with a set of humanoid legs through a chance encounter with Pre Vizsla™, Darth Maul rose to power in the underworld, by forming the Shadow Collective™ and eventually seizing control of Mandalore™ from Vizsla himself. Fueled by revenge against Obi-Wan Kenobi™ for that fateful battle on Naboo™, Maul continued his rage and rampage, ultimately facing off with his former master Darth Sidious™, which nearly brought about his demise.
Expertly sculpted using actual reference materials from the Lucasfilm archives, ARTFX Darth Maul stands ready for combat at an impressive 1/7 scale with his double lightsaber drawn. Twin removable energy blades allow you to display Maul right before he ignites his hilt. And the distinctive crown of horns atop his head and the red tattoo markings found on his face and chest denote his Zabrak™ heritage.
As an added bonus, an additional base extension is included so you can display the previously released ARTFX Ahsoka Tano™ (sold separately) with Darth Maul to recreate their breathtaking lightsaber duel! Display Darth Maul with the previously released ARTFX Ahsoka Tano™ and ARTFX Captain Rex™ to recreate the excitement of The Clone Wars™

The cockpit and equipment of both the normal type and heavily armored type are newly sculpted, allowing the model to be customized and reassembled freely. 
Add the Republic's special Zoid in line with GODOS to your collection today! 

Features:
• Two types of cockpits, normal and heavily armored, are included. Both can be opened and closed to hold the included pilot figure. 
• The arms, legs, and tail are articulated, and the Laser Claws move independently. 
• The Zoid Core in the torso is removable along with the lower part of the torso. 
• The Beam Cannon of the normal type and the Tank, Sensor Unit, Beam Launcher, and Aiming Radar of the heavily armored type each have 3mm joints and are interchangeable. 
• The Smoke Discharger and Launcher are mounted onto the torso with 3mm connection points, allowing their angles to be adjusted up and down. 
• In addition to clear orange, a colorless clear version of the canopy and sensor parts are included to be customized freely with the color of your choice. 
• A large selection of newly created decals for emblems and caution marks are included, so users can fine-tune the look of their Zoid.

The model kit is about an impressive 509mm in length and 406mm in width, and packed with details and intricate sculpting. The various parts of the mecha have been separated into nine different colored runners, making it easy to recreate the battleship with a simple assembly. The main armament and antennas are articulated. The rib-like white structures and complicated piping allow for a clear view of the main engine contained within. The dedicated display base allows the battleship to be displayed in either horizontal flight mode or advancing while breaking through the L-Barrier boundary with deep rolls. The main wings and left/right fuselage sections are designed to be removable even after assembly, allowing for easy display and transport.

Specifications:
• Ready-to-assemble non-scale plastic model kit with stand included. Approximately 509mm in length and 406mm in width.

New tools, new inspiration!

Plastic model tools are evolving fast. You may feel content with your current set--but one try of a new tool could change everything. Discover the excitement and efficiency that next-generation tools bring. They might just reignite your passion for the hobby!

A well-worn, familiar tool that fits perfectly in your hand is more than just an instrument—it's your trusted partner. Yet, many modelers have had that eye-opening moment when trying out a new tool, only to realize how much it improves accuracy, efficiency, or detailing capabilities. That discovery often becomes the turning point that makes you exclaim, “This is it!”—even motivating you to reopen kits that had been shelved for years.

Discover the joy of modeling with the right tools! Plastic models offer endless creative possibilities--and the key to unlocking them is having the right tools. This updated volume expands on Scale Model Basics and Beyond Vol.1, showcasing essential tools, new techniques, and expert tips to level up your modeling game.
