Carry your beloved Lookup figure on all your adventures with this charming Lookup pouch from MegaHouse. Designed with a delightful trunk-style motif, it evokes the playful image of your favorite character stowing away in your travel bag.

Equipped with sturdy metal fittings, it's easy to attach a carabiner or chain, letting you clip it securely to your bag or belt for convenient portability. It's the perfect accessory for enthusiasts who want to bring their figures along on outings, blending cute styling with practical functionality.
- Trunk-inspired design

- Metal fittings for attaching to bags or belts

products.title: Monster Hunter Reed Diffuser: Mizutsune ~The scent of bubbles shimmering in the moon~
products.description:
Starting with top notes of apple and lemon, the middle note expresses the glossy appearance of Mizutsune with floral scents of muguet and jasmine. The last note is a refined fragrance of musk, leaving a delicate aftertaste as if the bubbles released from the fragrance are shimmering in the moonlight.

- Manufacturer: GSI Creos

- Series: Monster Hunter

products.title: Monster Hunter Reed Diffuser: Felyne ~The scent of a beautiful stroll~
products.description:
The fragrance starts with bergamot, which expresses the pleasant spring air, and the middle note is softly floral, as if you are strolling in a beautiful forest where Felyne lives under the sun. The last notes are white musk and vanilla, which expresses Felyne's loveliness.

- Manufacturer: GSI Creos

- Series: Monster Hunter

products.title: Monster Hunter Reed Diffuser: Melynx ~The scent of a tomboyish expedition~
products.description:
The top note is a refreshing green and citrusy scent that expresses Melynx's mischievous spirit. In the middle notes, rose and jasmine give a peek into the unforgettable cuteness of the fragrance. Finally, woody amber and musk remind us of the sea of trees where hunters are advancing.

- Manufacturer: GSI Creos

- Series: Monster Hunter

products.title: Monster Hunter Reed Diffuser: Potion ~The scent of Peaceful herb ~
products.description:
In the top notes, lavender and other aromatic scents spread gently to soothe the hunter's tired body and wounds. The middle note is floral and all-embracing, echoing rose. In the last note, a deep fragrance with the sweetness of tonka bean gently encourages the body and mind.

From the anime series "Bungo Stray Dogs" comes a rerelease of the Nendoroid of Ryunosuke Akutagawa, a member of the Port Mafia that has strong control over the ports. He comes with three face plates including his standard expression, a bloodcurdling combat expression and an intrepid smiling expression.
Optional parts include effect parts from his ability "Rashomon" in its "Black Beast" and "Early Blooming Sakura" forms. Various interchangeable hand and leg parts are included to recreate notable poses from the series, like his pose with his hand to his mouth. Be sure to add him to your collection along with the other Nendoroids from the Bungo Stray Dogs series (sold separately)!

Made at GSC's 'Lucky Factory' in Tottori, Japan. This product will be made at Good Smile Company's 'Lucky Factory' in Tottori, Japan. The product will be proudly 'Made in Japan', and sent all over the world for fans to enjoy!

[Specifications]
• Painted ABS&PVC non-scale articulated figure with stand included. Approximately 100mm in height.

[Notifications]
• Images shown are sample prototypes. Some specifications may differ from the actual product.
• Paintwork is done partially by hand and therefore final products may vary.
• This product does not balance on its own. Please use the included stand.

- Manufacturer: ORANGE ROUGE

- Series: Bungo Stray Dogs

products.title: Mr.UV Curing Clear Putty
products.description:
Clear putty that cures under sunlight or UV light. We have adjusted the texture and adhesive strength for model use.

We have designed the resin so that you can add water-based hobby colors to create colored UV putty.

(Please use it after about 5 minutes after mixing. Do not add more than 5% of the putty. If you add too much paint, curing failure or extension of curing time will occur.)

 

*Please use a commercially available UV light.

 

[Features] 

・Composition design so that it can be colored with water-based hobby colors. Recommended is the water-based hobby color edition color no source

・Because it has a feeling of meat, it is easy to make thick ones

・ Less tackiness after curing

・Even if a new putty is applied on top of the hardened clear putty and hardened, it will not easily peel off from the cross section that has been applied.

・You can use it on a foil seal to make a simple jewel seal.
- Manufacturer: GSI Creos

- Series: No Series

products.title: Base Float
products.description:
Create an all-new display with adjustable translucent support arms! Wondering how to display more items with your ever-growing collection? The Base Float series is here to aid you! Base Float is a series of adjustable translucent support arms that can be placed below figure bases to elevate them. Subtle but functional, this product allows you to stack multiple figures on top one another to fully utilize your display space. Each set can be used with figure bases ranging from 7cm to 18cm in diameter. Use multiple sets together for even bigger items! [Set Contents] • Arm x 10 • Extension joint (5mm) x 10 • Extension joint (15mm) x 10 • Rubber bushing x 20 [Specifications] - Translucent ABS base support arms. products.description:
CONTENTS OF THE SET :
• Ultra Clear Coat PART A (High Solid Clear) 30ml x2
• Ultra Clear Coat PART B (Hardener) 35ml x1
• 2K Thinners 30ml x1

SAFETY PRECAUTIONS
This product contains Isocyanates. Vapours and Spray Mists are harmful if inhaled. May cause irritations to the skin, eyes, nose and throat. May cause headaches, nausea, and dizziness. Refer to SDS for further information.
ENSURE ADEQUATE PERSONAL PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT (PPE) RATED FOR WORKING WITH ISOCYANATES IS USED AT ALL TIMES AND ADEQUATE VENTILATION OF WORKSPACE IS ACHIEVED.

HOW TO USE :
Mix at a ratio of 2:1 + 10% Thinners. Example, 10ml PART A + 5ml PART B (HARDENER) + 1.5ml THINNERS. Mix only what you need to use. Once Part B (Hardener) is added to Part A (High Solid Clear), the chemical reaction begins and will be unusable within 30-40 minutes.
PART B (HARDENER) HAS A SHELF LIFE OF 6 MONTHS AFTER OPENING. Ensure the surface you are painting is smooth and dust free. Airbrush a light mist to act as a ‘tack’ layer and leave for approximately 5 minutes. Then apply in an even wet coat. If required, add another wet coat after another 5 minutes. Allow 24 hours to harden and cure.
To remove any dust particles etc afterwards, polish out using an appropriate grit sandpaper and reapply the Ultra Clear Coat over the area once again.
Drying times at ambient temp 20 – 22C : Dust Free – 30 minutes, Tack Free – 12 hours, Fully hardened – 24 hours. Can be polished and buffed after 24 hours minimum.

DOWNLOAD WORKING WITH ISOCYANATES & READ FULLY BEFORE USING THIS PRODUCT :
https://www.safeworkaustralia.gov.au/system/files/documents/1702/guide-to-handling-isocyanates.pdf

SDS PART A : https://www.scalemodeller.com.au/2KCLEARMSDSPKA.pdf PART B : https://www.scalemodeller.com.au/2KCLEARMSDSPKB.pdf

products.title: Baldur's Gate 3 Playing Cards - Collector's Edition
products.description:
The Baldur's Gate 3 Playing Cards - Collector's Edition are crafted for those who dare to roll the dice and challenge destiny. Each card inspired by the heroes and villains of Faerûn. Draw your hand wisely… your fate may depend on it.
These cards are no mere trinket. Printed on premium paper stock and housed in a gilded collector’s box, this deck is a true treasure of the Baldur's Gate 3 universe
This deck contains a rich cast of illustrated Baldur's Gate 3 characters including Astarion, Shadowheart, Wyll, Karlach, Lae’zel, Gale and many more.
Printed on premium-quality paper and housed in an elegant foil-stamped collector’s tuck box, the deck captures the grandeur, mystery, and epic atmosphere of the Baldur’s Gate 3 universe. Whether for collection, display, or everyday handling, every detail reflects its craftsmanship and collectible value.
The deck features many fan-favorite Baldur’s Gate 3 characters, including Astarion, Shadowheart, Wyll, Karlach, Lae’zel, Gale, and many other iconic faces from across Faerûn.
Choose carefully before you draw.
Because the next card in your hand may very well decide your fate.

- Manufacturer: Room One Cards

- Series: Baldur's Gate III

products.title: Baldur's Gate 3 Playing Cards - Magic Edition
products.description:
Let the bard’s overture begin,
Let the druid awaken the power of nature,
Let the cleric bear witness to divine miracles.
TheBaldur's Gate 3 Playing Cards - Magic Edition gather the magic, faith, and adventurous spirit of Faerûn into a single deck. Encased in a mysterious and regal royal purple tuck box with shimmering blue foil details, the design echoes the colors of the “Weave” itself — the unseen magical fabric that sustains every spell and arcane force.
As you examine the tuck box and card designs closely, you’ll discover intricate magical ornaments, arcane symbols, and weapon motifs belonging to mages and spellcasters. Every detail feels as though it conceals a hidden incantation, waiting to be awakened.
The deck features many beloved Baldur’s Gate 3 characters, including Astarion, Shadowheart, Wyll, Karlach, Lae’zel, Gale, and many other iconic faces from across Faerûn.
Open this deck,
and let the Weave flow once more.

- Manufacturer: Room One Cards

- Series: Baldur's Gate III

products.title: Baldur's Gate 3 Playing Cards - Multiclass Edition
products.description:
A sword in one hand, magic in the other.
Who says an adventurer must choose only one path?
The Baldur's Gate 3 Playing Cards - Multiclass Edition are dedicated to adventurers who refuse to be bound by a single class. Whether you are a warrior charging into battle with blade in hand, a druid channeling the power of nature, or a cleric blessed by the gods, this deck brings together the diverse powers, beliefs, and fighting spirit of Faerûn into one extraordinary set of playing cards.
The tuck box features a deep crimson color scheme accented with black and gold foil details, creating an atmosphere that is both luxurious and filled with the spirit of battle. Within its intricate patterns, you’ll discover arcane symbols and weapon motifs belonging to mages, knights, and adventurers of every kind. Every design element feels like a record of a legendary conflict where sword and sorcery intertwine.
The deck includes many fan-favorite Baldur’s Gate 3 characters, including Astarion, Shadowheart, Wyll, Karlach, Lae’zel, Gale, and many other iconic faces from across Faerûn.
When blade and magic are wielded together,
your next step will be yours alone to decide.

- Manufacturer: Room One Cards

- Series: Baldur's Gate III
